parent.R48_failure: OOD context 1 regret .297572, 24/32 gate flips, Native backbone zero ablation

hypothesis.main: Selecting the two highest observed public B key-states as candidate causal events before learning the public-context-dependent role preference prevents a negative context-1 attention slope from allocating most probability to numerous small-key nuisance events when history length increases.
hypothesis.scope: The two-event selection is a transparent HAND-CODED architectural inductive bias, NOT learned event discovery or a Native-specific effect. Only the subsequent context-dependent role selection is learned by gradients.
hypothesis.falsifier: If learned event selector fails either seed on fresh FIT/CAL/OOD, trained raw-history attention or fully trained conventional alternatives match its transfer, or causal-tag and fifth ablations do not hurt, do not claim robust learned mechanism.
hypothesis.context: Public-context 0 true cue tag 0.42, decoy tag 0.18; context1 true cue tag 0.18, decoy tag 0.42. Distractors have observed keys of 0.00 or 0.03, never a private marker; choosing two strongest tags is source-specific and must NOT imply arbitrary-world robustness.

source.nuisance_tag: tag=0.03 if t%3==0 else 0.0 for non-causal selected B records, forcing eligibility to be relative rather than exact zero detection
source.B_cue_and_decoy: selected physical deltas +amplitude*gate and -amplitude*gate at distinct SHA256-derived positions per panel/group, mapped context-wise onto observed tags 0.42/0.18
source.B_observed_encoding: _record(observed_tag, selected_action, observed_tag+physical_delta, public_context) with effect[4] zeroed; physical effect[0] stays
source.paired_mean_parity: For opposite gates at fixed context,q,group and split, entire normalized 16-channel B arithmetic means and public action-key means must match; individual selected B effects differ
source.fifth: Selected probe 0.42, action=public_context, actual R32 quartic selected fifth consequence; decode measured physical following by adding real probe before state ONCE
source.fit_calibration: FIT 16 training group q-balanced selected fifth outcomes only; no hidden q, generator physics constant, CAL or OOD data
source.return_laws: R32 original quartic FIT/CAL; R41 original cubic OOD, return state 0.61 or 0.73 by group parity; squared distance to goal1.0
source.reference: Observable-only deterministic top-two public-key and FIT-centered selected fifth rule must make zero mistakes in all 192 FIT+64 CAL+64 OOD worlds or stop before training

arms.name: event_context_selector
arms.type: learned slopes per public context, initialized 0, over top two selected public B keys; trainable gain

arms.name: raw_context_selector
arms.type: R48-like learned slopes per public context over all selected B history; identical factual FIT data

arms.name: event_global_selector
arms.type: one globally learned slope over top two public-key events

arms.name: event_uniform_control
arms.type: forced equal attention on top two events with trainable gain; no learned role preference

arms.name: event_context_native
arms.type: event context selector plus actual independently trainable R34 Native factual memory and fusion; Native gain must be proven by ablation

arms.name: gru_context_control
arms.type: fully trained GRU on same public selected tag/delta sequence and context, plus identical FIT-only fifth offset

methods.optimizer: AdamW; slopes/gain lr .02; GRU/Native weights lr .001; weight decay 0; grad norm clip 1; all arms see identical source and draws
intervention_panels: erase observed B public tag key
force same context-0 slope on both public contexts
methods.full_cost: Record trainable effective params, optimizer steps and train/test/total CPU wall; do not claim capacity/compute matched broad model superiority.

preregistered_score.if_native_zero_ablation: Attribute benefit only to explicit event selection and context role reader; Native incremental claim FAIL
preregistered_score.if_failed_gate: Preserve original negative result without post-score tuning or reusing consumed cohorts

qualification: Complete unchanged G4 Ubuntu+Windows full suite; G5 authentic Native TTT CPU both OS; G7 pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu; exact candidate SHA, original artifacts and action parity required.
